goal: Barkdown can operate itself: a barkdown command line and an app tool for assistants drive the running app as a person does, and a Full YOLO switch that only a person reaches opens settings, profiles and deletions.
scope: A. The command catalogue, the gate in the main process, the CLI and its launcher
B. The window carries commands out with the functions a click calls: chats, messages, notes, tabs, terminal, favorites
C. Full YOLO: a switch in Settings only; admin commands need it; no command switches it, quits or restarts
D. The assistant's app tool on the run's bridge; proof with a real assistant
E. Pictures, check, push, chain, nightly
acceptance: The barkdown CLI drives the running app in a live tour: an agent added and answered, a note created, tabs and the terminal used
Admin commands are refused without Full YOLO; with it they work; the switch, quit and restart are never commands (unit and live)
A real assistant inside Barkdown starts a helper chat with the app tool and changes a setting only after a person switched Full YOLO on
Delivered in a nightly from a green chain
nextAction: Implementation (de839e39) and pictures are committed. Remaining: push, chain on the pushed commit, nightly, then close the task.
